title.en: A brief account of evolution and the origin of man
title.kn: ಜೀವವಿಕಾಸದ ಸಂಕ್ಷಿಪ್ತ ವಿವರಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾನವನ ಉಗಮ

hook.en: Our story includes fish that crawled onto land, dinosaurs that vanished, and ape-like ancestors who stood up on the grasslands of East Africa.
hook.kn: ನಮ್ಮ ಕಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೆಲಕ್ಕೆ ಬಂದ ಮೀನುಗಳು, ಕಣ್ಮರೆಯಾದ ಡೈನೋಸಾರ್‌ಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಪೂರ್ವ ಆಫ್ರಿಕಾದ ಹುಲ್ಲುಗಾವಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನೇರವಾಗಿ ನಿಂತ ಪೂರ್ವಜರು ಇದ್ದಾರೆ.

narration.en: Our story includes fish that crawled onto land, dinosaurs that vanished, and ape-like ancestors who stood up on the grasslands of East Africa.
narration.kn: ನಮ್ಮ ಕಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೆಲಕ್ಕೆ ಬಂದ ಮೀನುಗಳು, ಕಣ್ಮರೆಯಾದ ಡೈನೋಸಾರ್‌ಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಪೂರ್ವ ಆಫ್ರಿಕಾದ ಹುಲ್ಲುಗಾವಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನೇರವಾಗಿ ನಿಂತ ಪೂರ್ವಜರು ಇದ್ದಾರೆ.

body.en: About 2000 million years ago the first cellular forms of life appeared. Invertebrates were formed and active by about 500 mya; jawless fish probably evolved around 350 mya. Lobefins evolved into the first amphibians; a lobefin, the coelacanth, was caught in South Africa in 1938, though thought extinct. Amphibians gave rise to reptiles with thick-shelled eggs. About 200 mya some land reptiles went back into water as fish-like reptiles (Ichthyosaurs), and dinosaurs dominated the land; the biggest, Tyrannosaurus rex, was about 20 feet tall. Dinosaurs suddenly disappeared about 65 mya; mammals then spread across the world.
body.kn: ಸುಮಾರು 200 ಕೋಟಿ ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಹಿಂದೆ ಮೊದಲ ಕೋಶೀಯ ಜೀವಿಗಳು. ಲೋಬ್‌ಫಿನ್‌ಗಳಿಂದ ಉಭಯಚರಿಗಳು, ನಂತರ ಸರೀಸೃಪಗಳು. ಸುಮಾರು 6.5 ಕೋಟಿ ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಹಿಂದೆ ಡೈನೋಸಾರ್‌ಗಳು ಕಣ್ಮರೆಯಾದವು; ನಂತರ ಸಸ್ತನಿಗಳು ಹರಡಿದವು.

Lobefins evolved into the first amphibians; a lobefin, the coelacanth, was caught in South Africa in 1938, though thought extinct. Amphibians gave rise to reptiles with thick-shelled eggs. About 200 mya some land reptiles went back into water as fish-like reptiles (Ichthyosaurs), and dinosaurs dominated the land; the biggest, Tyrannosaurus rex, was about 20 feet tall. Dinosaurs suddenly disappeared about 65 mya; mammals then spread across the world.

body.en: About 15 mya, Dryopithecus and Ramapithecus existed; they were hairy and walked like gorillas and chimpanzees. About 2 mya, Australopithecines lived in the East African grasslands, hunted with stone weapons and ate fruit. Homo habilis, the first human-like being, had a brain of 650–800 cc and probably did not eat meat. Homo erectus (about 1.5 mya) had a brain of about 900 cc and probably ate meat. Neanderthal man (1400 cc) lived in the near east and central Asia between 1,00,000 and 40,000 years back and buried the dead. Homo sapiens arose in Africa and spread; modern Homo sapiens arose during the ice age between 75,000 and 10,000 years ago. Pre-historic cave art developed about 18,000 years ago, and agriculture about 10,000 years ago.
body.kn: ಸುಮಾರು 1.5 ಕೋಟಿ ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಹಿಂದೆ ಡ್ರಯೋಪಿಥೆಕಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ರಾಮಾಪಿಥೆಕಸ್. ಹೋಮೋ ಹ್ಯಾಬಿಲಿಸ್ ಮಿದುಳು 650–800 cc, ಹೋಮೋ ಎರೆಕ್ಟಸ್ ಸುಮಾರು 900 cc, ನಿಯಾಂಡರ್ತಾಲ್ 1400 cc. ಹೋಮೋ ಸೇಪಿಯನ್ಸ್ ಆಫ್ರಿಕಾದಲ್ಲಿ ಉಗಮಿಸಿತು.

points.en: H. habilis 650–800 cc → H. erectus 900 cc → Neanderthal 1400 cc

problem.en: Arrange in order of increasing cranial capacity and say which one probably first ate meat: Neanderthal man, Homo habilis, Homo erectus.

steps.en: Neanderthal man: about 1400 cc. NCERT says Homo erectus probably ate meat, while Homo habilis probably did not.

answer.en: H. habilis < H. erectus < Neanderthal; Homo erectus probably ate meat

body.en: Habilis, Erectus, Neanderthal: 7, 9, 14 hundred cc (habilis averages about 700).
